tests.name: Whole-trip browser test (12 steps)
tests.result: 24 passed, 2 skipped (the place-order step, off by default), desktop and phone

tests.name: Single-flow browser tests (22 flows)
tests.result: 36 passed, 6 failed, 2 skipped (device-specific), desktop and phone. The 6 failures are 3 real gaps, each seen on desktop and phone: no price sort, no delivery estimate in the pincode check, and placeholder text on live pages

tests.name: Page speed on a phone (Lighthouse)
tests.result: Home 78, shop 83, product 87, checkout 94, quote 93. Accessibility 98 to 100, best practices 100, SEO 100 (checkout is 60 on purpose: it is hidden from Google). Desktop was 99 to 100 in the earlier run

tests.name: Page and address check (31 addresses)
tests.result: 26 pages open (200). Missing: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, web manifest, share image, llms.txt (404)

tests.name: Search-engine tags on 20 pages
tests.result: Titles and descriptions are there. No canonical link, no share (Open Graph) tags, no product structured data on any page

tests.name: Store set-up probe
tests.result: Cash on delivery on, Cashfree hidden by choice, flat-rate delivery (₹60 plus GST), CGST and SGST for Maharashtra, IGST for Delhi, in-transit fields, reviews, contact and 3D-model routes all answer

tests.name: Security re-check
tests.result: Fixed: public username list in the REST API, author redirect, login error text, plugin list. Still open: WPGraphQL still lists the admin username, readme.html is still public

tests.name: Emails
tests.result: All 12 designs render without errors with stand-in orders, and the send-once rule passes 15 checks. NOT tested: a real email in a real inbox

tests.name: Not tested on purpose
tests.result: Creating a customer account, sending a quote with a file, sending a contact message, subscribing, posting a review and placing another order: each would create real records on the live store. These were tested earlier on a stand-in store
